videos.title: Jensen Huang Is Back at Nvidia. What Happens Now? | Market Hang
videos.description:
Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, and the market hang panel debates what it means for the AI trade. Did Washington just signal that the AI trade is too big to fail? The panel weighs key-man risk, the US-China AI race and whether last week's selloff was really about Jensen or about data center politics, tighter credit and the Fed. They debate how bullish to be on a 1 to 5 scale, whether the next wave of value is in AI apps, and whether AI needs a speed limit or an FDA-style regulator. Featuring Gil Luria, Darius Dale, Christopher Zook and Liz. Christopher Zook is an investor in Anthropic and OpenAI.
